content.text: I'll help you create an open-top box with the specified dimensions. Let me first calculate the inner dimensions and positions for creating this hollow box structure.

# Given outer dimensions
outer_length = 220  # mm (x-direction)
outer_width = 300   # mm (y-direction)
outer_height = 160  # mm (z-direction)

# Given thicknesses
wall_thickness = 8   # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Calculate inner dimensions
inner_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness  # 220 - 16 = 204 mm
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness    # 300 - 16 = 284 mm
inner_height = outer_height - bottom_thickness    # 160 - 12 = 148 mm

# Calculate position for inner block (centered in x and y, raised by bottom thickness in z)
inner_x = wall_thickness  # 8 mm
inner_y = wall_thickness  # 8 mm
inner_z = bottom_thickness  # 12 mm

print(f"Outer box dimensions: {outer_length} x {outer_width} x {outer_height} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity dimensions: {inner_length} x {inner_width} x {inner_height} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity position: ({inner_x}, {inner_y}, {inner_z})")
